quotes.en: implementing clear policies and procedures over internal reporting, reporting to the JFIU, post-reporting risk mitigation and prevention of tipping off

quotes.en: The AML/CFT Systems should include: (a) appointment of an MLRO (see Chapter 3)
quotes.tc: 打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度應包括： (a) 委任一名洗錢報告主任（請參閱第3章）

quotes.tc: 備存內部報告及可疑交易報告的妥善紀錄

quotes.en: post-reporting risk mitigation and prevention of tipping off
quotes.tc: 作出報告後如何減低風險及防止通風報訊

doubts: All five statements depart from ¶7.7/¶7.9, so this reads as a none-of-the-above item. Here: the Guideline names the MLRO, not the compliance officer, as the central reference point (actor).
Staff and MLRO training is required elsewhere (Chapter 9) but is not one of the three ¶7.7 elements of the STR systems.
¶7.7(c) sets no retention period, nor do the chapter 7 record provisions (¶7.29–7.30); 'at least seven years' is added.

doubts: All five pairs contain one item s.13(2)(c) does not list, so this reads as a none-of-the-above item. Here: date and place of birth is a wire-transfer particular (s.12(3)(c)), not a remittance one.
The originator's account number is a wire-transfer particular (s.12(3)(b)), not in s.13(2)(c).
The recipient's account number is a wire-transfer particular (s.12(3)(e)), not in s.13(2)(c).
The travel document number is required (as the originator's identification document number), but s.13(2)(c)(ii) requires the place, not the date, of issue.
